text: The central park playground should rebuild. With the latest design, which is designed to be impact-absorbing, exceeding the safety code, it seems like a fantastic opportunity to enhance the park's overall safety and environment for children. A climbing forest concept that exists nowhere else in the state is also a significant reason to rebuild. A regional grant covering materials will provide financial relief, ensuring the project can happen without significant delay. The harbor playground thrived, so it is possible that similar revitalization could also yield positive results. In fact, if the city is willing to put in the extra effort, the benefits could be substantial.
